versions.changelog: 更新飞书语音消息发送说明：推荐使用 feishu-voice-api skill
添加飞书语音消息发送说明：mp3需转ogg格式才能显示为语音消息
Add requires/install/credentials sections; clarify multi-channel support; add security warnings

- Added support for direct text input: generate TTS audio from plain text without OCR.
- Updated documentation to clarify input types (photo or text) and corresponding flows.
- No code or functional changes; only SKILL.md was modified for clearer instructions.

- Updated installation instructions for the Chinese Tesseract OCR language pack, adding steps for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- No functionality changes; documentation only.

- Added bilingual support: now supports both English and Chinese (requires chi_sim language pack for Chinese OCR).
- Users can select TTS voice, language, and speed; defaults are set for each language.
- The workflow, OCR steps, and TTS instructions updated to include Chinese usage and configuration.
- Documentation reorganized for clarity, including available TTS voices and language setup instructions.
- Minor wording, formatting, and usability improvements.

- Added Chinese explanation to the skill description for better accessibility.
- No changes to code samples or functionality; documentation description improved only.

Initial release of article-tts skill.

- Extracts English article text from photos using OCR (Tesseract).
- Supports configurable workflow: optional text confirmation step before generating audio.
- Converts extracted text to natural TTS audio via Microsoft Edge TTS.
- Allows splitting audio by sentences on user request.
- Complete image pre-processing for improved OCR accuracy.
- Works seamlessly with Feishu for both input (photo) and output (audio).
